= Cloud August 28, 2026

[NOTE]
====
Kobiton now uses date-based release versioning. Instead of version numbers such as 4.26S or 4.19.3, releases are identified by the build date in YYYYMM.DD format. For example, 202608.28 represents a build created on August 28, 2026.

Cloud release notes are typically published weekly and summarize changes since the previous publication. +
Version information for individual software components is available in the Component versions section.
====

== Appium AI enhancements

- Full-resolution screenshots are now sent to the LLM by default, matching the resolution the accuracy benchmarks were measured at. To restore the previous 1080 px downscale (for example to reduce bandwidth or per-request cost), set `NaturalLanguageLocator.KeepOriginalScreenshot=false` in `dc.ini`.

== API v2

- The installed-applications API response now includes `app_version_id` alongside the existing device and application identifiers. The value matches `kobiton-store:v` from Appium scripts, so callers can compare installed apps against the intended version in the App Repository.

== Xiaomi device behavior

- Xiaomi devices now stay awake for the duration of long automation runs. Xiaomi's aggressive deep-idle behavior previously suspended sessions mid-run.
